page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 2.0 GB per core memory allocation. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, with Geekbench multi-core, stress-ng multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all placing in the middle 50 percent. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached large blocks also demonstrate average performance, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is positioned as a compute-optimized resource. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated vCPUs in parallel rather than relying on high single-thread performance. Suitable workloads include multi-threaded compilation, ray tracing, static web serving, and moderate database operations, as well as medium-sized LLM inference tasks where text generation speeds reach average thresholds.

This hardware profile is best suited for parallelizable, compute-heavy workloads such as multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation without requiring massive memory footprints.
